boot.unavailableBody: The local Toskar service has not responded yet. Wait a moment and try again — if this keeps happening, check Diagnostics after the app loads.
boot.keyBody: This Toskar accepts connections from other devices, so it asks for an API key. Enter one to continue. Over plain HTTP, a key doesn't encrypt your traffic.

loadError.title: Toskar couldn't load this
loadError.body: It didn't answer, or answered with an error. Your data is still there. Try again, or see Diagnostics if it keeps happening.
